meta_description: GJM Auto-Electrical Sheffield. Expert car electrical repair, diagnostics and battery service. Fast, reliable, competitive rates. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Charging issues, faulty alternators, or warning lights? We diagnose and fix car electrics fast, keeping you on the road.
services_subhead: From battery replacement to full rewires, we handle all car electrical faults with speed and expertise.

services.title: Battery & Charging System Repair
services.desc: Dead battery? Struggling to start? We test, repair or replace batteries and alternators on the spot, with brands you trust.

services.title: Starter Motor & Ignition Diagnostics
services.desc: Engine won't turn over or clicks repeatedly? Our quick diagnostics pinpoint the fault and get you back on the road same day.

services.title: Fault Code Diagnostics
services.desc: Warning lights on your dash? We plug in our diagnostic scanner, read the fault codes, and advise the best repair path.

services.title: Wiring & Rewire Work
services.desc: Corroded wires, faulty connectors, or new accessory installation. We trace and repair electrical faults throughout your vehicle.

services.title: Lighting Repairs & Upgrades
services.desc: Headlights, brake lights, or interior bulbs not working? We replace and upgrade your lighting safely and professionally.

services.title: Accessory Installation
services.desc: Adding a reversing camera, sat-nav, or dash cam? We install and wire it correctly, with a clean, professional finish.

about_pullquote: We fix cars properly, first time. No guesswork, no inflated bills.
about_para_1: GJM Auto-Electrical has been serving Sheffield motorists for 18 years. We started because we were tired of seeing people ripped off by dealerships for simple electrical jobs. Today, we're known across Sheffield for honest diagnostics, fair pricing, and electrical work that lasts.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed and transparency. We diagnose most faults in 30 minutes and explain exactly what needs doing before we touch a spanner. Whether it's a £40 bulb or a complex rewire, we treat your car with respect and keep costs realistic.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an issue with my alternator and couldn't face the dealer rip-off. Called GJM and they diagnosed it straight away. Fitted a quality replacement in an hour, saved me nearly £200 compared to the main dealer. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: My battery died on a Saturday morning and I was panicking. They fitted a new one and had me on my way before noon. Professional lads, no messing about, fair price. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Took my Mondeo in with warning lights everywhere. They tested it properly, explained what was wrong, and only charged me for what actually needed doing. Rare to find an auto sparks you can trust. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.
